name: show_file
description: Show a file of the thread's workspace to the person: in the web app a card with its name, size, a preview (a web page live, an image, audio to play, the start of a text) and a download button; on a chat channel (WhatsApp) the file itself after your reply, an image as a picture, audio as a voice note, anything else as a document. Use it to send what a tool made. Only shows it; there is no reply.

path.description: The file, relative to the workspace, e.g. site/index.html

title.description: What the card is titled; the file's name when left out
